raw.query: WITH v AS (SELECT n_images, mean_ms AS vllm_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine='vllm' AND image_px=448 AND source_path LIKE '%vllm_eager_dense%' AND is_valid), a AS (SELECT n_images, aic_ms FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE engine='aic_postinfill' AND image_px=448) SELECT MAX(ABS((v.vllm_ms - a.aic_ms) / a.aic_ms * 100)) AS max_abs_dev_pct FROM v JOIN a USING (n_images) WHERE v.n_images <= 64
raw.observed: 12.71% max absolute deviation at N=52 (64 points, all within ±12.8%)
